// WHAT THIS IS: The load list for src/orchestration/definitions.py. Set an asset to false and it is NOT LOADED - gone from the UI, from `*`, and from every selection. true or ABSENT = enabled, so a newly added asset is on by default.
// NOT THE RUN PLAN: This is not switch_config.json. The ordinary way to not run something is to not select it, and to skip one inside a bigger run use `--select "group:cafef and not key:\"raw/cafef_news\""`. Use this file only for `must never load in this repo`.
// DOWNSTREAM IS NOT DISABLED: Dagster keeps the edge and shows a disabled node as an unexecutable external asset, so bronze/cafef_index_price still resolves with its raw/ parent off. To stop a chain, disable the downstream too.
// A TYPO IS AN ERROR: A key here that matches no asset RAISES at load time and lists the valid keys. That is deliberate - a silently-ignored key is the exact failure switch_config.json's trailing-slash bug had.
// ---- RUNNING JUST bonds / funds / for: All 12 keys of those three chains are listed below and TRUE. Selection is what scopes a run, not this file - the whole three-class pipeline, scrape included, is:  --select "*gold/bonds,*gold/funds,*gold/forex"  (drop the leading * to skip the Selenium scrape and rebuild from raw_data/ on disk). Set the OTHER keys false here only if you want the rest of the repo to stop loading entirely.
// ---- ... the 12 keys ----: raw/trading_view_links + raw/trading_view_data (partitioned - the bonds/funds/forex PARTITIONS are what these chains use), bronze/trading_view_{bonds,funds,forex}, silver/{bonds,funds,forex}, gold/{bonds,funds,forex}.
// raw/trading_view_collected_links: nothing reads this - kept because main.py runs the phase
// raw/cafef_news: HEAVY - ~2 h, ~405k rows over the full universe
// bronze/cafef_financials: writes SIX tables from one ingest
// bronze/simplize_stocks: 2.7 M rows - the biggest table in the layer
// ---- silver: the three TradingView pr: straight projections of one bronze table each; the grain gold/{name} pivots
// ---- silver: the CafeF carry-ups + th: these nine had NO asset before 2026-08-05 - 9.5M rows reachable only by calling a DataPreprocessor method
// silver/cafef_financials: ONE method, THREE tables - the per-report statement carry-ups
// silver/cafef_financials_bank: the 3 bank statements carried up, then joined wide per quarter (180 cols)
// silver/stocks_basic_financials_bank: daily x quarterly, as-of on publish_date - INNER, bank tickers only
// silver/cafef_news: 395k articles cleaned + de-duped + ALIGNED TO A SESSION (trading_date is the look-ahead guard); needs silver/stocks_basic for the calendar
// gold/economy: WIDE: 1 row per business day, 1 col per series, as-of filled
// ---- gold: the three WIDE TradingView: none is as-of filled, unlike gold/economy
// gold/bonds: 9 tenors x 13 measures = 117 cols; the VN01/VN01Y twins are asserted identical, then collapsed
// gold/funds: 19 HOSE ETFs x up to 19 measures = 351 cols; replaces the long 22-col feature table
// gold/forex: 328 broker-quoted pairs, ONE value column each = 328 cols; no features (328 x 13 would exceed PostgreSQL's 1600-column ceiling)
// gold/stocks: The per-stock price/flow panel, ~2.4M stock-days x ~42 cols, adjusted OHLC, NO derived columns
// gold/stocks_ta: HEAVY - gold/stocks + the ~900-column TA block over 2.4M rows: hours, ~11 GB
// gold/stocks_financials_bank_fa: FEATURE panel: the _fa source + the full TA battery, ~1.1k columns
// gold/news_weekly_panel: 497k ticker-WEEKS, news + event counts, no sentiment - the panel the if_news baseline runs on
// gold/news_daily_panel: DAILY twin of the weekly panel - trailing 5/10-session news windows for rel5/rel10
// ---- unified: ONE ticker, cut into fe: the schema is created by the asset
// unified_vcb/pool__basic: every column of silver.stocks_basic for VCB, silver's own types
// unified_vcb/pool__targets: date + return_5day (forward 5-day simple return on the adjusted close)
